description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Ireland national public-holiday offset. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need an employer-selected benefit day or non-national schedule.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts Ireland national working days in exact 2026-2027 coverage.
Example user requests: Add one Ireland working day after 2027-01-29.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2027-01-29","working_days":1}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, holiday_names, calendar_scope, good_friday_policy, weekend_holiday_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: move one day at a time; decrement only on Ireland status.is_working_day=true
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/ireland-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/ireland-add-working-days.md

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_ireland_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: National statutory public holidays over a Monday-Friday baseline.

good_friday_policy.description: Good Friday is not a public holiday.

holiday_names.description: National statutory public holidays applying on the date.

sources.description: Official Irish government regulator and legislation sources.

weekend_holiday_policy.description: No automatic next-working-day closure is inferred.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Ireland Working Days
